key.name: display-mode
key.description: Either "percentage" (show the number) or "icon" (show a battery icon colored red/yellow/green by charge level).

key.name: show-backlight
key.description: Whether the top bar shows the keyboard brightness next to the keyboard's battery.

key.name: backlight-display-mode
key.description: Either "percentage" (show the number), "level" (show the current level) or "bar" (show a level bar).
